_why: The signature mechanics: the one thing that makes a Decennial boss play differently from the next. 'kind' is what the code does (shield_pulse, thorns, blood_pact, enrage, add_tithe, blink_strike, frost_aura, scorch_aura, venom_aura, gravity_well, echo_strike, kite_ward, mirror_guard, mana_leech), 'power' its strength as a share (0 to 0.5, clamped) and 'period' its beat in seconds (2 to 120). Every kind harms health, magicules or position and nothing else: no kind touches the food bar.

phylactery_ward.text: Its phylactery renews a ward of soul-stuff every twenty seconds.

grave_tithe.text: Every servant that dies feeds it a little ward.

bone_aegis.text: Bone spurs turn a share of every blow against its attacker.

stolen_light.text: It drinks the magicules of those who stand close.

crown_of_ruin.text: After two and a half minutes the crown burns and it strikes harder.

oathbreaker_charge.text: It vanishes and strikes from behind a random hero.

dread_presence.text: Stay far away and it grows a ward and comes for you.

hex_cauldron.text: A green miasma poisons everyone near it.

sanguine_pact.text: While its brood lives, it takes a quarter less damage.

sanguine_echo.text: A fifth of its blows land twice.

infernal_contract.text: Every eighteen seconds the contract pulls the party in.

frost_heart.text: Cold gnaws at everyone close to it.

mirror_veil.text: Arrows and bolts are turned aside, and some turn back.

radiant_ward.text: A ward of light closes round it every eighteen seconds.

sacred_thorns.text: Holy thorns return a share of every blow.

oath_of_dawn.text: It will not be fought from afar: a ward grows, and it comes.

stone_covenant.text: While its guardians stand, it takes a fifth less damage.

storm_charge.text: It arrives in a flash of lightning at a hero's side.

star_pull.text: Every sixteen seconds the stars pull the party in.

dragon_pride.text: After two minutes its pride flares and it strikes much harder.

devil_union.text: After three minutes the union deepens and it strikes harder.

root_tithe.text: The roots feed it a ward for every devil that falls.

tide_ward.text: The tide closes a ward round it every sixteen seconds.

void_hunger.text: The void drinks the magicules of those who stand close.

rime_shell.text: A rime of frost spreads from it and slows what it touches.

ember_heart.text: Its heart is a forge: whatever stands close is scorched.

thorn_mantle.text: A mantle of thorns bites those who strike it.

gilded_ward.text: Its gold hardens into a ward every twenty-two seconds.

judgement_echo.text: Its verdicts are given twice: some blows land again.

web_of_fate.text: Venom hangs round it in a fine mist.
